sections.title: Specification reviews
sections.sql: select * from packaging_week order by findings desc,code

sections.title: Open evidence checks
sections.sql: select code,name,rule,issue from compliance_findings order by code,rule

sections.title: Nominal mass per pack
sections.note: Declared component weights and recycled percentages. Not measured waste, recyclability or a statutory return.
sections.sql: select product_code,product,mass_per_pack_g,claimed_recycled_g from packaging_mass order by product_code
